methodsAttempted.B_careersPage: Every direct fetch was egress-blocked: bookingholdings.com/careers/about/, jobs.booking.com, careers.booking.com, careers.priceline.com, kayak.com/careers, boards.greenhouse.io, job-boards.greenhouse.io, and jobs.ashbyhq.com (a control fetch of en.wikipedia.org was also blocked, confirming WebFetch is unusable environment-wide, not host refusal). companyNotes: Booking Holdings is a holding company; every early-career opportunity found lives with its brands, each on its own ATS: OpenTable and Agoda on job-boards.greenhouse.io, KAYAK on jobs.ashbyhq.com/kayak, Priceline on careers.priceline.com (Workday), Booking.com on careers.booking.com/jobs.booking.com. Current geography of early-career hiring: OpenTable runs a Toronto internship cluster (SWE, iOS, Data, MBA Product, AI Automation — CAD $42/hr, hybrid); KAYAK's US early-career entry points are full-time Associate roles in Cambridge/Concord, MA, while all its engineering internships are currently Kaunas/Berlin only (excluded by geography); Priceline's structured summer internship (Norwalk/NYC) ran Jun 1-Aug 7 2026 and is finished — watch careers.priceline.com in fall for the Summer 2027 posting; Booking.com's early-career funnel is the Compass programme (apprenticeships/internships/graduate schemes) in Amsterdam, Manchester and Shanghai — the Manchester Software Engineering Graduate Programme (careers.booking.com/booking-com-compass-software-engineering-graduate-programme-2/) starts September 2026 with applications that opened in January 2026, so the window had passed by this run date; re-check around Jan-Feb 2027 for the next UK-eligible intake. Agoda's internships/new-grad analyst roles are Bangkok-based (relocation sometimes provided) — outside allowed countries. Booking Holdings corporate (Norwalk, CT) showed only senior openings (VP FP&A, Senior Associate Corp Dev, Senior Counsel). Caveat for the checker: this sandbox's egress proxy blocked ALL direct page fetches (LinkedIn, every brand careers domain, Greenhouse, Ashby, even a Wikipedia control), so every record above comes from search-engine-indexed pages, descriptionRead is false throughout, and visa fields default to Not Mentioned — liveness, deadlines, and sponsorship language should be re-verified from a network that can reach the listing URLs.
